categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily manufactures, processes, and sells low-density polyethylene (LDPE) and ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer resin (EVA). It also engages in plastic raw material trading, machinery wholesale, and investment activities. The product portfolio includes various grades of LDPE and EVA, such as film grade, injection grade, coating grade, foam grade, photovoltaic grade, and specialty cable materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes autoclave manufacturing processes for LDPE and EVA production, enabling the production of high-grade, customized products. It has developed proprietary technologies for low melting point coating-grade EVA and hot melt adhesive EVA products. The company is also advancing in recycling plastic materials and has obtained ISO 14021 certification for pre-consumer recycled content, reflecting its commitment to circular economy practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves domestic and international markets, with LDPE mainly sold domestically and EVA predominantly exported. Key markets include China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia (Vietnam, India, Cambodia, Indonesia, Bangladesh), and Western countries. Customers are primarily in packaging, footwear, photovoltaic modules, wire and cable insulation, and other industrial applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung and Taipei headquarters. The company has subsidiaries and investments in Shanghai, BVI, and other locations. Sales and exports cover Greater China, Southeast Asia, India, and Western markets, with strategic efforts to reduce reliance on the Chinese market by expanding into other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the petrochemical supply chain, producing polymer resins (LDPE and EVA) from ethylene and vinyl acetate monomers sourced primarily from Taiwan CPC and Dalian Chemical. It also engages in downstream trading and distribution of plastic raw materials. Investments in ethylene storage and pipeline infrastructure enhance upstream supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing differentiated, high-value EVA products such as photovoltaic-grade, foam-grade, and hot melt adhesive grades. The company invests in recycling technologies and circular economy initiatives to reduce costs and environmental impact. R&D focuses on improving product quality, expanding specialty grades, and enhancing production flexibility with AI and digitalization for energy efficiency and process optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of LDPE and EVA resins. The company also earns income from plastic raw material trading and investment returns from subsidiaries. Sales are based on volume and pricing contracts with customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with Taiwan Polyethylene and Formosa Plastics in the domestic market, particularly in LDPE and EVA production. It holds a significant domestic market share in LDPE due to limited local production by competitors. The company positions itself through product differentiation, focusing on high-value and specialty EVA products to mitigate price competition from Chinese producers expanding capacity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported year, the company had consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.03 billion, a 10.2% decrease from the prior year, with a net loss of NT$750 million. Production volume was stable with slight decreases in output but increased sales volume. The company is investing in capital expenditures such as ethylene storage facilities and environmental protection equipment to support future growth and operational stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, customization, and differentiation, especially in specialty EVA grades like coating, photovoltaic, and hot melt adhesive products that face less competition from Chinese producers. It leverages proprietary manufacturing technologies and a flexible production system to meet diverse customer needs. Commitment to sustainability through recycled materials and energy-efficient processes further differentiates its offerings.
